name: Cable Single-Arm Bent-Over Row
steps: Face a low pulley in a staggered stance, hinge forward and reach for the handle with one hand.
Drive the working elbow toward your hip to bring the handle beside your lower ribs.
Reach toward the pulley until your arm extends.
Switch sides and repeat the movement.
tips: Keep your spine long and your shoulders level.
Avoid jerking your torso upward or rotating open as you pull.
